title: HB1082 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-02-05; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 3102884)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2025-02-05 (as filed; summary says 'As introduced'). Section 2 is a cross-reference edit to 39-17-1302(d). Amendments, if any, are not in the text read.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1302(a)(8)): (8) A switch or auto sear device designed, made, or intended for use in converting a weapon to shoot automatically more than one (1) shot, without manual reloading, by a single function or pull of the trigger.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1302(f)(5)): (5) An offense under subdivision (a)(8) is a Class E felony.
